workflows.title: SCAIL 2 character animation
workflows.description: SCAIL 2 motion transfer in ComfyUI: animate your AI character with the moves from any video. Free workflow for AI influencer and cartoon videos.
notes: Replace prompt placeholders and supply your own input images, video or audio before running.
workflows.body:
Motion transfer puts **your character** into any video. Add a character image and a driving video (a dance, a walk, a talking clip) and the workflow repaints the video with your character copying the motion. This version uses SCAIL 2 (Wan 2.1), which tracks the person you pick in the video by name, like "person on the left".

**Great for:**
- AI influencer dance and motion videos
- Animating cartoon and anime characters with real movement
- Picking one person out of a multi-person clip

### How it works
1. Load your character image and the driving video.
2. Say who to track and write a detailed prompt.
3. Run it to get the video and an extended continuation.

### Want better results with less work?
[Wan Animate / SCAIL 2 God Mode](/premium-workflows/wan-animate-god-mode/) is the plug-and-play version of this workflow. It includes both Wan Animate and SCAIL 2 in one pack and adds:
- **Automatic prompting:** an AI prompt writer fills in the prompt for you
- **Sharper, smoother video:** detail passes, upscaling and frame interpolation
- **More control:** replace the person, keep the original background, or replace a custom region
- **Ready to run:** a matching RunPod template, a step-by-step guide and a private Discord support channel

### Make it yours with LoRAs
This workflow supports LoRAs. Grab character, style, anime or cartoon LoRAs from [CivitAI](https://civitai.com) or [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co), drop them into the LoRA loader, and keep your AI character looking the same in every shot.

workflows.title: Wan 2.2 text to image
workflows.description: Use the Wan 2.2 video model to make photorealistic AI images from text. A free ComfyUI workflow for AI influencer and character photos.
notes: Replace prompt placeholders and supply your own input images, video or audio before running.
workflows.body:
Wan 2.2 is one of the most popular open-source AI video models, known for realistic motion and strong prompt following. It also makes excellent still images: this workflow renders a single high-resolution frame, which often looks more natural than image-only models.

**Great for:**
- Realistic AI influencer photos
- Character portraits and concept art
- Start frames for your Wan videos

### How it works
1. Write your prompt.
2. Run it through the high noise and low noise stages.
3. Save your 1536x1536 image.

### Tip for higher quality
Remove the turbo LoRA from the high noise sampler, raise CFG to 2.2-3 and add a few more steps. Generation gets slower, but motion and detail improve.

### Make it yours with LoRAs
This workflow supports LoRAs. Grab character, style, anime or cartoon LoRAs from [CivitAI](https://civitai.com) or [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co), drop them into the LoRA loader, and keep your AI character looking the same in every shot.

settings.label: Steps
settings.value: 3 per sampler (high noise and low noise)

workflows.title: Wan 2.2 SVI four-pass V3
workflows.description: Make AI videos up to 20 seconds long with Wan 2.2 SVI. Chain four scenes, each with its own prompt and LoRAs, into one smooth clip.
notes: Replace prompt placeholders and supply your own input images, video or audio before running.
RIFE downloads its checkpoint on first use; the listed path is the frame-interpolation node's default cache.
workflows.body:
Most AI video models stop at about 5 seconds. This Wan 2.2 video extension workflow (SVI) chains **four 5-second segments** into one continuous video of up to 20 seconds.

**Great for:**
- Chaining several actions into one story
- Longer AI influencer and character videos
- Cartoon scenes that continue naturally

### How it works
1. Load your start image.
2. Write a prompt for each of the four segments. Each segment can also use its own LoRAs.
3. Run it. The segments are blended together, upscaled and interpolated to 60 fps.

### Tip for higher quality
Remove the turbo LoRA from the high noise sampler, raise CFG to 2.2-3 and add a few more steps. Generation gets slower, but motion and detail improve.

### Make it yours with LoRAs
